title: FlowDoc Browser Backend Compatibility
summary: Current only for bounded local loopback browser compatibility evidence: headless Chrome opens rendered Editor product routes against a live loopback Backend, covers the product-report minimal read/migration/mutation smoke, and covers the default four-document Backend corpus for library/design-route read plus UI migration. Deployed, cross-browser, non-default or broad production corpus, accessibility, visual-regression, and product-readiness claims remain unknown.
